metadata.description: Agent Treasury by Tempora Labs — treasury management plugin for AI agents. Open source, starting with yield on idle USDC and USDG: measured vault registry on Base, Arbitrum One and Robinhood Chain, simulation-based pre-flight, unsigned deposit and withdraw calls for your own signer or your own browser wallet. Never holds a key.

plugins.name: treasury
plugins.description: Agent Treasury by Tempora Labs — treasury management plugin for AI agents; your own wallet holds the position. Ships the earn skill: measured vault registry, simulation-based pre-flight, unsigned deposit/withdraw builders, and a local confirm page for your own wallet. Holds no keys.
